auth.body: Send Authorization: Bearer <token>. Use an API key for your own scripts, or OAuth2 (authorization code with PKCE) for apps other organizations connect. Each token has scopes such as clients:read; it can never do more than the person who created it.

webhooks.body: We POST each event as JSON with Webhook-Id, Webhook-Event and Webhook-Signature headers. Compute HMAC-SHA256 with your endpoint secret over the timestamp, a period and the raw body, compare it with each v1 value and reject timestamps more than five minutes old. Failed deliveries are retried with backoff for about 72 hours; endpoints failing for three days are disabled. Events can arrive out of order: use occurred_at.

sandboxes.intro: A sandbox is a separate organization with a copy of your settings and sample data, for testing integrations safely. Payment, calendar and accounting connections are not copied.
